results.title: West Africa: Sahel - Limits of Mediation in the Face of Terrorist Violence - allAfrica.com
results.snippet: Between 2019 and 2025, jihadist groups doubled the number of their attacks in the Sahel. The frequency of these attacks has surged: from 1,900 in 2019 to over 5,500 in 2024, with 3,800 recorded by October 10, 2025--a total of 28,715 attacks over nearly six years.
